original_card.question: Can one reproducible environment or artifact-comparison failure be repaired?
methods: Reproduce one portability failure and add a minimal cross-environment fix.
Audit one canonical-payload comparison for omitted proof-relevant fields.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Preserve immutable source hashes and proof-relevant content; a different compressed byte stream alone is not a mathematical mismatch.

original_card.first_experiment: Reproduce one specific mismatch or audit one canonical comparison for omitted proof-relevant fields.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Portable exact checks prevent environment failures from blocking valid contributions.
allowed_variations: One interpreter/version mismatch or one payload field comparison.

actual_scope: Reproduce the PR379 verifier stop on five absent historical bytecode and log paths, then replay the retained low-read candidate, chart geometry, five-stage columns, lowering, 47-constraint assembly, and seven-stage complex coarse saving without accepting the PR370 full-replay kappa as this candidate.
scope_change_reason: The card asks for one portability failure whose repair keeps proof-relevant content. The named failure is the retained e8-low-read-seven-complex manifest at e01bcc51, not a gzip-container byte comparison. The missing paths are an interpreter bytecode file and four logs; deleting them would hide the stop without replaying the candidate.
bottleneck_link: A source-complete replay lets this retained historical candidate be checked on another interpreter without treating an environment file, or the older PR370 kappa, as the mathematical result. It does not change the selected supplier.
stop_rule: One package at the retained PR379 head. Stop after the candidate word, charts, columns, lowering, assembly, and bundled seven-stage complex script. Do not rerun frontier1094 or treat the absent full-source logs as regenerated.
evidence: On Python 3.12.3 the original verifier raises FileNotFoundError at code/__pycache__/outer.cpython-311.pyc before any receipt check. The five absent manifest paths are exactly that bytecode file plus proof/signed-source/run.log, provenance/full-replay-cp311.log, provenance/full-replay-cp312.log, and source/signed-source/run.log. The retained full-replay receipt kappa is 875481145306751/10^18 on both interpreters, not the candidate 3618278388573/4000000000000000. Fresh candidate-certificate verify.py matches its retained RESULT.json, including the five-stage histogram and the floored bit coarse 905388584776183/10^18. Regenerated ALL-CHARTS.json and CHART-RECEIPT.json match the retained bytes; a one-bit record mutation does not. columns_h.cpp matches col.json except the input path and elapsed seconds, with 1345 formal columns. lower_and_bank.py reproduces LOWERING-BANKS.json and GLOBAL-PROGRAM.bin sha256 b702c84c6d10e7445e5d3401377391048289193fde01765488cff1fde748efc4. assemble.py reproduces assembly.json, including 47 strict constraints. The bundled PR363 verify.sh reproduces b = 932783231884153/10^18.
